# Satvik Sabharwal

> Portfolio of Satvik Sabharwal, a frontend-focused full-stack developer based in Chemnitz, Germany, with 6+ years of experience building React, Next.js and TypeScript products. Currently Frontend Engineer at Staffbase SE.

The site is a single page per language with sections for about, skills, projects, experience and contact.

## Pages

- [Portfolio (English)](https://satviksabharwal.com/en): Background, skills, projects, work experience and contact form
- [Portfolio (Deutsch)](https://satviksabharwal.com/de): German version of the same page

## Projects

- [PhotoVoltaic System](https://thesolarsense.online/): React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Supabase
- [CalorieCam](https://app.calorie-cam.workers.dev/): React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Supabase
- [Sci-fi inspired Portfolio](https://github.com/satviksabharwal/sci-fi-3D-portfolio): Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Framer Motion
- [Data Management Platform](https://github.com/satviksabharwal/data-management-platform): React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB
